statusDefinitions.implementedAndAccepted: Available implementation and reviewed, source/artifact-bound real SDK evidence for every declared profile and chain
statusDefinitions.pendingAcceptance: Implementation, reviewed parameter/platform scope or real SDK evidence is incomplete
statusDefinitions.platformNotApplicable: Documented platform restriction; never used for missing implementation

implementationDefinitions.present: Concrete platform adapter registration exists; see implementationState and documented scope
implementationDefinitions.delegated: Requires explicitly supplied host account/payment service
implementationDefinitions.runtimeOwned: Protected wire boundary; does not assert implementation
implementationDefinitions.absent: No platform registration inventoried; inspect core source roles

implementationStateDefinitions.missing: No implementation source found; a protected boundary alone does not count
implementationStateDefinitions.partial: Core bridge/facade or implementation has an unresolved provider or parameter scope
implementationStateDefinitions.available: Concrete core or platform implementation source found; acceptance remains separate
implementationStateDefinitions.requiresHostService: Installed client requires a configured host account/payment backend

responsibilityDefinitions.runtime: Core app execution, rendering, managed state or package lifecycle; this does not assert implementation.
responsibilityDefinitions.device: OS/browser services, physical devices, network/media or managed native files; this does not assert platform availability.
responsibilityDefinitions.hostService: Host account, permission policies, domain backend or payment integration; credentials stay outside guest JS.
responsibilityDefinitions.ecosystem: WeChat/platform ecosystem product or service; actual official integration conditions must be reviewed.

Shared private-ledger plain storage with single-publication transactions, UTF8 logical quotas and native core-commit ACK. JSON float_roundtrip preserves normalized JavaScript Number bits; key admission matches the existing native Unicode White_Space policy. Storage-only reconciliation settles accepted guest intent before later host writes or baseline replacement even if public event conversion fails. Async encrypt:true is explicitly rejected; lone-surrogate strings and bounded new-value depth/batch sizes limit JSON parameter scope; accounting is a documented container policy rather than measured WeChat byte parity. SDK persistence/namespace and Web KV durability acceptance remain separate

restriction.reason: The locked official API contract documents setWifiList as an iOS-only callback for the iOS system Wi-Fi list. Android has no corresponding platform-specific callback contract.

restriction.scope: General-purpose iOS containers using public platform APIs
restriction.reason: Apple provides no general-purpose Wi-Fi scanning API. HotspotHelper requires an Apple-approved entitlement and is restricted to hotspot integration; it cannot be used as a general container scanning service.
